div.div: بَذِىٌ , (T, M, Msb, K,) or بَذِىٌ اللِّسَانِ, (S,) A man foul, unseemly, or obscene, in tongue: (T, S, M, * K: *) or lightwitted, weak, stupid, or ignorant, in behaviour; and foul, unseemly, or obscene, in speech; and so though speaking truth: (Msb:) fem. with ة: (S, Msb:) and pl. أَبْذِيَآءُ. (T.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
